location.site_description: West of the Creek Turnpike between East 11th Street South and East 21st Street South in East Tulsa / Fair Oaks Innovation Park

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11; Meta announced the Tulsa Data Center groundbreaking on 2026-04-21, and TMAPC approved a Project Anthem accelerated release of a building permit on 2026-05-20.
evidence_grade: A - official developer announcement plus city planning, council, and utility records

actions.result_status: The trade inventory lists an Anthem Data Centers Tulsa planning-stage project. It does not establish the company identity, parcel, approval, construction, or status.
actions.access_caveat: Discovery-only trade source; no primary record was found and no approval or 800 MW figure is adopted as verified.
actions.evidence_note: Body/context retained from prior file: Electrical industry trade publication.

actions.result_status: Council agenda item tied the Local Development Act Tax Exemption Agreement to a conditional development and financing agreement among the City of Tulsa, Tulsa Authority for Economic Opportunity, and Atmoss, LLC for development of a data center project under the Project Anthem Economic Development Project Plan and Supporting Tax Incentive District.
actions.evidence_note: Official city council document page; establishes Atmoss, LLC and data center project identity.

actions.action_type: accelerated release of building permit - electrical substation
actions.result_status: Staff report recommended accelerated release of building permits limited to the Project Anthem electrical substation; preliminary plat had been approved on 2024-08-07. The report listed a 16.80-acre substation site and 339.11-acre full Project Anthem site.
actions.evidence_note: Official TMAPC staff report for Project Anthem PSO substation.

actions.result_status: Meta announced Tulsa, Oklahoma as its next AI data center, with construction underway, investment of more than $1 billion, more than $25 million in local road and water infrastructure improvements, more than 1,000 peak construction workers, and approximately 100 operational jobs.
PartnerTulsa reported Meta broke ground on a Tulsa data center at Fair Oaks Innovation Park, spanning more than 2 million square feet, with Fortis Construction as general contractor.
actions.evidence_note: Official local economic development organization announcement.

actions.action_type: preliminary plat extension and accelerated release of building permit
actions.result_status: TMAPC approved the Project Anthem preliminary subdivision plat extension to 2027-08-07 and approved accelerated release of a building permit for Project Anthem per submitted plans.

TMUA agenda described a revised will-serve letter between the City of Tulsa and Atmoss, LLC for Project Anthem, increasing previously approved peak water usage from 2.75 MGD to 5.7 MGD and wastewater flow from 500,000 gpd to 1,950,000 gpd, with additional 16-inch water main and Supplemental Carbon Treatment Improvements at LBCWWTP.

owner: Meta Platforms, Inc. (publicly announced operator/developer); local Project Anthem agreements and utility records use Atmoss, LLC

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: Prior file listed Tulsa County. Official plat-related text and the 2024 tax agreement context point to Wagoner County taxing entities / Wagoner County plat language for the Project Anthem site while the city remains Tulsa.
contradictions.resolution: Updated county to Wagoner and retained city as Tulsa.

contradictions.description: No official MW capacity was located in current official developer, city planning, council, or utility documents. Trade/tracker capacity figures, if any, are not adopted.
